title_sq: Ne Qender, Shiten 3 Apartamente Te Investuara Per Qira Ditore!!!
description_sq: Ne Qender Tek Bar Piazza Shiten 3 Apartamente Te Investuara Dhe te Ndare Per Airbnb! Apartamentet kane nje siperfaqe neto 110m2 dhe fizikisht 124m2. Jane te ndare ne nje 1+1 dhe 2 Studio dhe ndodhen ne katin e 3 nga 5. Prona eshte konceptuar, projektuar dhe e rikonstruktuar totalisht me punime dhe arredim cilesor me nje vlere investimi rreth 120 mije euro dhe ne gjendje pune si biznes per qira ditore . Lokacioni i prones eshte perfekt per qira ditore dhe me orientim mjaft te favorshem ne te 3 drejtimet Lindje-Jug-Perendim, me nje organizim te hapesires shume funksionale per te tre njesite. Per menaxhimin e njesive si te ndara apo te perbashketa per aksesin si dhe eficencen energjitike ne perdorimin nga klientet per AirBnB & Booking, porta kryesore per secilen njesi jane te pajisura me akses nepermjet kodit dhe karte aksesi qe menaxhon. Investimi ne kete prone perllogaritur mbi te ardhurat vjetore 38 k EURO pergjate vitit 2025 dhe kostot optimale ne operimin dhe mirembajten ne saje te investimit te kryer, siguron nje kthim investimi me nje norme shume te larte (10 - 12 vite). Prona eshte ne perdorim si biznes per qira ditore , me nje performance te shkelqyer vleresuar nga Booking me TRAVELLER REVIEW AWARDS 2025! Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In the Center, 3 Invested Apartments for Daily Rent!!!
description_en: In the center of Bar Piazza, 3 apartments are sold, invested and divided for Airbnb! The apartments have a net area of ​​110m2 and a physical area of ​​124m2. They are divided into a 1+1 and 2 Studio and are located on the 3rd floor out of 5. The property has been conceived, designed and completely reconstructed with quality work and furnishings with an investment value of about 120 thousand euros and in working condition as a daily rental business. The location of the property is perfect for daily rent and with a very favorable orientation in the 3 directions East-South-West, with a very functional space organization for all three units. For the management of units as separate or joint for access as well as energy efficiency in use by customers for AirBnB & Booking, the main gate for each unit is equipped with access through the code and access card that it manages. The investment in this property calculated on the annual income of 38 k EURO throughout the year 2025 and the optimal costs in operation and maintenance thanks to the investment made, ensures a return on investment with a very high rate (10 - 12 years). The property is used as a business for daily rent, with an excellent performance evaluated by Booking with TRAVELER REVIEW AWARDS 2025! The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
